title: South Fergus servicing agreement and water capacity buy-back
subtitle: Also: tree canopy grant application, new donation and sponsorship policy, and a radio antenna on Gartshore Water Tower.
overview: Council approved the funding strategy for a Service Financing Commitment Agreement with two developers for detailed engineering design of municipal services to the South Fergus lands {{vote:m6}}. The work covers roads, water, wastewater and stormwater, and the agreement sets out cost-sharing between the developers and the Township before development can proceed.

Council endorsed a Water Capacity Buy-Back Program {{vote:m3}}. Large industrial, commercial, institutional and community water users who have completed a water audit can receive a one-time incentive of up to 50% of retrofit costs, to a maximum of $10,000. Council also authorized an application to the Federation of Canadian Municipalities for tree canopy funding, with a $22,300 in-kind Township contribution {{vote:m2}}.

Council adopted an amended Donation, Sponsorship and Naming Rights Policy and delegated authority to sign agreements to two senior staff roles {{vote:m4}}. It also approved a licence for The Grand 101 to place a relay antenna on the Gartshore Water Tower {{vote:m5}}. Consent items included approval to demolish a listed property at 22 Carlton Place, Elora, and endorsement of a councillor's OSUM nomination {{vote:m1}}. Jason Benn was introduced as the new Fire Chief.

decisions.detail: Council approved the funding strategy for the Service Financing Commitment Agreement with Westbow Fergus GP Ltd and Salem Development Company for detailed engineering design of municipal services to the South Fergus Lands.
Council endorsed the program and its terms, offering eligible large water users a one-time incentive toward water efficiency retrofits.
Staff may apply to the Federation of Canadian Municipalities for urban forestry funding, with a $22,300 in-kind Township contribution and delegated signing authority for the support letter.

decisions.item: Donation, Sponsorship and Naming Rights Policy
decisions.detail: Council adopted the amended policy, repealed By-law 2023-04, delegated agreement signing to the Managing Director of Community Services and the CAO, and directed staff to bring back related Delegation of Authority By-law amendments.

decisions.item: Radio antenna licence at Gartshore Water Tower
decisions.detail: Council authorized a non-exclusive licence agreement allowing The Grand 101 Radio to install and maintain a relay antenna on the water tower.

Council approved routine items including an emergency preparedness grant agreement and $32,637.47 in spending, demolition of the listed property at 22 Carlton Place, Elora, and endorsement of a councillor's OSUM Executive Committee nomination.
